statement: Inspected upstream stable Linux v6.12.113 HID core rechecks the driver match during probing, including explicit binding. The generic driver rejects a special-driver match unless an ignore-special policy or quirk applies. Its HID device attribute group provides no driver_override. This explains the local bind refusal as a source-consistent host boundary; it does not authorize changing global policy, adding a quirk or changing the device model. Debian-specific differences and alternative per-device mechanisms were not exhaustively audited.
